## Rules

- Атрибуты не имеют runtime parser dependency; AST scanner не boot-ит пакеты. Metadata coverage/name resolution/PHPDoc generics/inherited signatures fail closed. Report exit 0 debt != strict success; parser/config error exit 2. No namespace wildcard trust; single scanner owner for manifest/docs/graph. Golden разрешён лишь new Attribute/scanner records, остальные слои не меняются.

## Guidance

dossier §3.1 algorithm, examples §1/§2. Frontier choices bounded by source ownership and full typed graph; no optional skip of unresolved PHPDoc. Input-manifest digests checked before consuming raw maps; facts script is read-only.

## Implementation Rules

## Validation

- `scripts/php84 composer test -- --filter=Attributes` → fixture positives + every negative in examples §2 passes; attribute metadata and enum roundtrip tested.
- `scripts/php84 php scripts/php-api.php --report --format=json` → exit 0, emitted report has discovered declarations + debt; `--strict` on current unclassified tree → exit 1; malformed scratch fixture → exit 2.
- Double `--write` on fixture tree → byte-identical manifests; parameter rename, enum/default change and nested foreign Internal type fixtures cause precise failures.
- `composer module-layout-gate` → 159 unchanged baseline records, no new/stale, Attributes exact exception controls green; old existing tree rules stay bound.
- `php scripts/package-graph-gate.php` → exit 0 with current namespace semantics preserved until P04.4.

- `scripts/php84 composer lint:check`, `scripts/php84 composer analyse` → exit 0; `php scripts/quality-ceiling-guard.php` → `ceilings OK`; no threshold weakening.
- `scripts/php84 composer test`, `PGSQL_PORT=5432 scripts/php84 composer test:pg`, `scripts/php84 composer test:packages`, `scripts/php84 composer test:arch` → exit 0; isolated `_test` DB preflight before DB tests, PHP8.4 required. Existing P03 count is reference, preserved behavior proven by affected assertions.
- `scripts/php84 composer golden` → 4 tests pass **without** GOLDEN_UPDATE. D64 preimage/candidate/semantic-delta/review proves each updated layer; routes byte-identical to item preimage.
- `php scripts/rename-completeness-gate.php`, `php scripts/ownership-gate.php --strict`, `php scripts/package-docs-gate.php`, `bash scripts/anti-weakening-gate.sh`, `bash scripts/mutation-check.sh --all` → exit 0 (new gates get negative controls; preserve 34 existing mutation cases).
- Independent review: execution-sheet reviewer/effort, fresh context; reviewer model != executor; item-spec + diff + Validation + semantic delta; `review: <provider>/<model> <GREEN|findings:N>`; <=2 fix/recheck rounds, then concrete unresolved boundary evidence.
